comment:
* Access network manager manages the qualified/available networks for mobile data connection.
 * It binds to the vendor's qualified networks service and actively monitors the qualified
 * networks changes.

variables.name: EVENT_GUIDE_TRANSPORT_TYPE_FOR_EMERGENCY
variables.comment: Event to guide a transport type for initial data connection of emergency data network.

variables.name: mApnTypeToQnsChangeNetworkCounter
variables.comment: * The counters to detect frequent QNS attempt to change preferred network transport by ApnType.

variables.name: mAvailableNetworks
variables.comment: Available networks. Key is the APN type.

variables.name: mPreferredTransports
variables.comment:
* The preferred transport of the APN type. The key is the APN type, and the value is the
     * transport. The preferred transports are updated as soon as QNS changes the preference.

variables.name: mAccessNetworksManagerCallbacks
variables.comment: * Callbacks for passing information to interested clients.

methods.name: private void reportAnomaly(@NonNull String anomalyMsg, @NonNull String uuid)
methods.comment:
* Trigger the anomaly report with the specified UUID.
     *
     * @param anomalyMsg Description of the event
     * @param uuid UUID associated with that event

methods.name: private void bindQualifiedNetworksService()
methods.comment:
* Find the qualified network service from configuration and binds to it. It reads the
     * configuration from carrier config if it exists. If not, read it from resources.

methods.name: private String getQualifiedNetworksServicePackageName()
methods.comment:
* Get the qualified network service package.
     *
     * @return package name of the qualified networks service package.

methods.name: private String getQualifiedNetworksServiceClassName()
methods.comment:
* Get the qualified network service class name.
     *
     * @return class name of the qualified networks service package.

methods.name: public void registerForQualifiedNetworksChanged(Handler h, int what)
methods.comment:
* Register for qualified networks changed event.
     *
     * @param h The target to post the event message to.
     * @param what The event.

methods.name: private void setPreferredTransports(@NonNull List<QualifiedNetworks> networksList, boolean forceReconnect)
public int getPreferredTransport(@ApnType int apnType)
methods.comment:
* Get the  preferred transport.
     *
     * @param apnType APN type
     * @return The preferred transport.

methods.name: public int getPreferredTransportByNetworkCapability(@NetCapability int networkCapability)
methods.comment:
* Get the  preferred transport by network capability.
     *
     * @param networkCapability The network capability. (Note that only APN-type capabilities are
     * supported.)
     * @return The preferred transport.

methods.name: public boolean isAnyApnOnIwlan()
methods.comment:
* Check if there is any APN type preferred on IWLAN.
     *
     * @return {@code true} if there is any APN is on IWLAN, otherwise {@code false}.

methods.name: public void unregisterForQualifiedNetworksChanged(Handler h)
methods.comment:
* Unregister for qualified networks changed event.
     *
     * @param h The handler

methods.name: public void registerCallback(@NonNull AccessNetworksManagerCallback callback)
methods.comment:
* Register the callback for receiving information from {@link AccessNetworksManager}.
     *
     * @param callback The callback.

methods.name: public void unregisterCallback(@NonNull AccessNetworksManagerCallback callback)
methods.comment:
* Unregister the callback which was previously registered through
     * {@link #registerCallback(AccessNetworksManagerCallback)}.
     *
     * @param callback The callback to unregister.

public void dump(FileDescriptor fd, PrintWriter printWriter, String[] args)
methods.comment:
* Dump the state of access networks manager
     *
     * @param fd File descriptor
     * @param printWriter Print writer
     * @param args Arguments
